data.summary: E218 completed: Fresh observation in academic research domain (OpenAlex topics). Accessibility pattern ('fragmented ⇒ enterable') statistically validates for first time (Spearman ρ=0.604, p<0.0001, G3 PASS) but driven by cross-disciplinary differences, not within-topic variation. G2 FAIL (concentration range 0.006), G4 FAIL (coverage 87.8% due to Arts/Humanities low affiliation rates). All 50 topics eligible (G1 PASS). Result: pattern holds in academia but mechanism differs from market-entry hypothesis — no product candidate.
